Principal Product Manager, AI
- Saa S Labs Principal Product Manager, AI Job type: Full Time · Department: Product · Work type: On-Site Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Job details Application form Why this role exists Most AI product teams are busy shipping features. We're building Just Call's AI organization to ship outcomes
- creating AI experiences customers trust, adopt, and rely on every day. We are hiring a Principal Product Manager, AI to own the product strategy and execution behind Just Call's AI native communication platform
- anchored on our AI Voice Agent (AIVA), AI Conversation Intelligence and the next products we ship on the path to an intelligent, omnichannel communication OS. This is a senior, deeply hands-on product leadership role. You'll define the product vision, shape the roadmap and partner closely with Engineering, Design, and AI leadership to ship AI experiences that customers actually trust. You'll obsess over user problems, AI quality and the unit economics of voice. You'll be in the prompts, the evals and customer calls as much as you are in the strategy decks. What you'll actually do Own product strategy and roadmap for Just Call's AI portfolio
- AI Voice Agent (AIVA), AI Conversation Intelligence and the next AI native products we ship. Translate customer problems into sharp product bets. Stay close to customers
- listen to real calls, sit in on rollouts, run discovery sessions and turn what you hear into product decisions. Partner deeply with Engineering and AI leadership on architecture tradeoffs, model selection, eval frameworks and the build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls that shape the AI stack. Define and own the quality bar for AI experiences
- what "good" looks like for accuracy, latency, hallucination and customer trust Drive go-to-market alongside Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success
- pricing, packaging, positioning and enablement for AI products. What we're looking for 7+ years of product management experience in Saa S, AI/ML, or platform products
- with a track record of owning complex, customer-facing products end to end. Proven experience shipping AI-powered products at scale
- agentic systems, LLM applications, etc. Strong awareness of the AI ecosystem, including emerging models, platforms, startups and product launches. Stays current on industry developments and can translate advances in AI into meaningful product opportunities and competitive advantage. Strong technical fluency
- you can hold your own with engineers on model selection, RAG architectures, eval frameworks, prompting strategies, latency tradeoffs, etc. A bias toward being in the product
- you read traces, write prompts, test agent flows, and demo the work yourself. Deep customer empathy
- you have sat with users, listened to real calls, and translated messy signals into sharp product decisions. Operational rigor
- you ship measurable improvements in quality, adoption, and retention. Excellent judgment on when to go deep, when to delegate, and when to push back. Comfortable in fast-moving environments where the AI capabilities shift monthly and ambiguity is the default. Edges that help You've worked in adjacent spaces
- CCaa S, CPaa S, CRM, sales engagement, or conversation intelligence and understand how reps, managers, and ops teams actually work. You've navigated a platform transition from legacy Saa S to AI-native and know what it takes to drive that shift across product, engineering, and GTM. You have founder instincts
- you've operated lean, made fast calls, and owned the outcome. You've shipped voice or telephony products and understand the hard problems
- latency, turn taking, multilingual handling, real time orchestration. How we work Outcomes over output. We measure product impact by retention curves, revenue influence, and customer trust
- not features shipped. High ownership from day one
- you'll shape the product org, not inherit a finished one. Fast cycles, real ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring a sharp point of view and move quickly on it. Competitive pay tied to the product vision you set and the impact you drive. The bigger picture Just Call is Saa S Labs' flagship product

- Saa S Labs Founding AE
- Service Agent Job type: Full Time · Department: Service Agent · Work type: On-Site Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India Job details Application form Why this role exists Most service businesses still lose revenue to operational chaos hidden in plain sight
- missed calls, delayed scheduling, fragmented customer communication, manual invoicing, and teams juggling too many disconnected tools. Service Agent solves this as an AI Operations Platform that combines AI calling, scheduling, CRM, invoicing, payments, and customer communication into one unified system powered by AI Agents
- helping businesses run 24/7, capture more revenue, and grow without scaling operational overhead. This is a front-row seat to selling the shift from manual operations to AI-powered business infrastructure. What you'll actually do Own the full sales cycle end-to-end — from prospecting and outbound sourcing to demo, trial, negotiation, and close. No handoffs. Drive and manage the inbound motion — qualify, prioritize, and convert inbound leads efficiently using PQL signals and product usage data. Build and execute outbound sequences targeting high-fit ICP accounts — using AI tools, intent data, and personalization at scale. Run tailored product demos and POCs — connect product capabilities directly to each prospect's workflows and business goals, and own the outcome of every proof-of-concept you initiate. Lead trial success end-to-end — drive activation, measure value realization, and convert trials to paid with clear success milestones. Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene — own the CRM, deal trackers, and forecasting with defined milestones and use cases per opportunity. Actively contribute to GTM playbook development — document what works, share learnings, and help define how we scale the sales function What we're looking for Total experience of 7-10 years with 4–7 years of B2B Saa S sales experience in a closing AE role
- you've owned a quota, built a pipeline, and have consistent results to show for it. Proven full-cycle closure
- you've taken deals from cold outreach to sign contracts independently, without relying on an SE or pre-sales team to carry you across the line. AI-native seller
- you actively use AI tools (Claude, Chat GPT, Clay, Amplemarket, etc.) to research accounts, craft outreach, prep for calls, and close faster. This is non-negotiable. High EQ and elite communication
- you read rooms, adjust your pitch on the fly, and build trust quickly with both technical and business stakeholders. Founder-mode mindset
- you don't wait for processes to be handed to you. You build it, iterate, and share it. US market fluency
- you're comfortable working async or overlapping with US time zones and understand how US buyers evaluate and buy. You’re not afraid to pick up the phone to make cold calls to potential customers Edges that help Experience selling at an early-stage startup (seed or Series A) where you had to build process, not just follow it. Familiarity with PLG motions
- you've used product usage signals and PQL data to prioritize and convert trials to paid. You've built outbound sequences and ICP frameworks from scratch, not just executed what was handed to you. Annual offsite & numerous fun parties Real coverage for you and your family
- physical, mental, no fine print. Competitive pay tied to skill, experience and the value you ship. The bigger picture Built by Saa S Labs
- the team behind products like Just Call , Helpwise, and Call Page
- with 6,000+ customers, 300+ people across India, Poland and the US, backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners (raised over $55mil).
